items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: But then I had met Charlie Christian, he was just a youngster

ctx.x: When did you have -- no, when did you have the Centennial in Houston, Texas?
Oh, I don't know. I -- you see, because in the 30's I left Dallas for good in '28, which I was -- I'm going to come to. But then I had met Charlie Christian, he was just a youngster, and --
Because I saw him at Thomason Hall, in the ball room there.

items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: That's a great solo for Johnny Charlie Christian.

ctx.x: 'Soft Winds.' That's a great solo for Johnny Charlie Christian. Well, I did all of those things practically -- well, I won't say practically all of them, I must have made at least 15 or 20--
